newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds close at highs, await auction.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds close at highs, await auction.

text.p: Portuguese bonds closed off the highs and dealers said shorter bonds could rise further, but longer bonds would struggle to bring the yield spread against Bunds below 90 basis points (bps).
"June 1997 futures pulverised the previous resistance level of 107 points. There is a lot of optimism after the Ecofin meeting, but I don't foresee huge gains in the short term."
He added: "Most of the demand will be for shorter bonds. There will be a lot of demand at tomorrow's three-year fixed rate bond auction."
